title: Clean, deduplicate, decontaminate, score: one pass and a card for every gold set
request: Training data organised, structured and clean: nothing personal, no duplicate, nothing an evaluation reads.
spec: dclab_core/clean.py, the lake build's clean_decisions and clean_examples, eval_seeds, cards per set, make solver-data.
plan: Features must be pure states; personal identifiers dropped; near duplicates and evaluation rows out of train and dev; a quality score; a card per set.

decisions.decision: Only what identifies a person is personal data.
decisions.why: Row counts, feature ranges and prices in a study are its content; redaction's broad patterns are for people's free text.

decisions.decision: A self-play example of a table an evaluation reads is kept out of train and dev.
decisions.why: dev is the training run's validation file.

change: clean (impure, personal on JSON strings, near_key keeping digits, dedupe, quality with the reasoning part, cards), lake build, the test fixture's state field.

findings.defect: Most verified results and algorithm examples were dropped as personal data.
findings.scenario: Sixteen-digit metrics matched the card and identifier patterns.
findings.fix: Only JSON strings are checked, and only identifying kinds count.

findings.defect: 296 of 330 research answers were dropped as personal data.
findings.scenario: Row counts, V1-V28 and $50 matched the ID and amount patterns.
findings.fix: Only email, IBAN, card, IP, phone and address count.

findings.defect: Evaluation tables reached the validation file.
findings.scenario: selfplay:uplift:3 was kept in dev while benchmark v4's sealed run reads seed 3.
findings.cause: The seed filter applied to train only.
findings.fix: Train and dev; the programme's seed added.

findings.defect: Near duplicates ignored the numbers the examples are about.
findings.scenario: Results of other seeds collapsed into one.
findings.cause: Every digit was normalised to zero.

findings.scenario: A construction-only set claimed OpenML and people's labels.
findings.cause: Claims were one text per kind.
findings.fix: Claims follow the origins the rows have.

findings.defect: A fixture's state held a field no real state has.
findings.scenario: The purity check dropped the fixture rows.
findings.cause: The test used a made-up field g.
findings.fix: The fixture uses a real field.

outcome: Every gold set is cleaned, scored and carded; make solver-data rebuilds the lake and both training files.
lessons: A cleaning rule tuned for people's text must not be run on measurements.
risks: Self-play repeats in bands: after cleaning the solver families are a few hundred rows.
